name: OasisLMS Nexus
description:
Nexus is the AI data connector for OasisLMS, providing a secure bridge between Claude and your organization’s OasisLMS data.

With Nexus, OasisLMS clients can use natural language to access and analyze LMS data without needing to write database queries or navigate multiple reports. Claude can use Nexus tools to retrieve relevant OasisLMS information and help answer business, operational, and learning-related questions.

Nexus is designed to support a growing range of OasisLMS data, including:

• User and learner information
• Login and traffic activity
• Learning activity and engagement
• Exams, questions, and learner performance
• Course and content participation
• Purchase and transaction data
• Reporting and operational analytics

For example, users can ask questions such as which learners have been inactive recently, how engagement has changed over time, which courses are generating the most activity, how learners are performing on assessments, or what purchasing trends are occurring within the LMS.

Nexus securely connects each organization to its own OasisLMS environment using authenticated, permission-controlled access. Available capabilities will continue to expand as additional OasisLMS data and tools are exposed through Nexus.

_published_faq.name: How do I add OasisLMS Nexus to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add OasisLMS Nexus to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.oasis-lms.com/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the OasisLMS Nexus MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: OasisLMS Nexus provides these MCP tools: search_exam_question_maps, search_exam_questions, search_exams, and search_users.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to OasisLMS Nexus?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 18, 2026, alternatives to OasisLMS Nexus in productivity on the Manufact MCP catalog include Autodesk Product Help, BoardWise, FlagStat, Keenable Web Search, and PomoDial.

_published_faq.name: Does OasisLMS Nexus MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: OasisLMS Nexus requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
OasisLMS Nexus is developed by OasisLMS. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
